verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a sandboxed code interpreter and MCP integrations, including file-system access through third-party MCP servers, plus a titled Subagents page. None of it documents LibreChat supervising or embedding a real coding agent that clones repos, edits files and runs tests. These are adjacent building blocks or snippet-execution features, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As a developer, the assistant can supervise or embed real coding agents so it does repo work — cloning, editing, testing — not just snippets in chat
